from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Identifies a specific case referenced in the document."""
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The court handling the case")
    case_number: Optional[str] = Field(description="The official case number (e.g., (2022) 辽 01 执异 923 号)")

class InvolvedParty(BaseModel):
    """A person or entity involved in the case."""
    name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The full name of the party")
    role: Optional[str] = Field(description="Their role in the proceedings (e.g., Appellant, Defendant, Applicant)")

class MonetaryDetail(BaseModel):
    """Monetary figures mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="The numeric amount extracted")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency unit")
    description: str = Field(description="What the amount represents (e.g., Court fee, Fine, Illegal gain)")

class JudgmentDetail(BaseModel):
    """Specific details of the ruling or sentence."""
    text: str = Field(description="The text describing the ruling or sentence")
    is_final: bool = Field(description="Whether this is explicitly stated as final")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_identifiers: List[CaseIdentifier] = Field(description="Identified case numbers and courts")
    parties: List[InvolvedParty] = Field(description="List of parties and their roles")
    monetary_details: List[MonetaryDetail] = Field(description="Fees, fines, and amounts found")
    judgment_details: List[JudgmentDetail] = Field(description="Detailed outcomes and sentences")
    procedural_types: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Procedural nature (e.g., '二审', '执行异议复议')")
